name: com.1by3.nebula
description: Middleware for dynamically meshed multiplayer game servers: Unity dedicated-server workers that hand entities to each other, an orchestrator that hosts the control plane and stores the world in SQLite or PostgreSQL, and a gateway clients connect to.

samples.description: A reference validator built on NetworkIdentity.StateAt(tick): rewind candidates to the tick a client claims, test the shot there, apply the result on the victim's authority.
A thousand server-owned walkers in two relevance tiers: a spawner that gives each its update interval and priority, and a walker that carries what it needs across worker seams.
A character no player owns walks onto a moving platform with its own physics frame, rides it and walks off again, with no crossing code: the worker converts it as it does a player's pawn.
A car players drive: a kinematic vehicle model the driver's client predicts, and a driving seat that hands the controls to the seated player's client on the worker.

A ship flies from a planet's ground into space and back in one scope: a turning planet with its own physics frame and leased ground, a scripted flight in the planet's coordinates, and a client probe for jumps at frame crossings.
